title: Premium Disc (Translation Project V25.1, experimental)
scene_base_evidence: All 28 X1*.BIN scene programs start with the SH-2 export veneer and their first veneer target lies 0x100-0x2BD0 bytes into the image when loaded at 0605E000.

module_containers.evidence: PD X014 at 060897C4 matches 32 bytes of the verified Scenario 3 V25.1 effect loader (060896BC; index*0x8000 into 06048D00). The PD EFFECT.BIN is exactly 72 chunks of 0x8000 and all three header veneers in every chunk point inside the chunk loaded at 06048D00. Static loader mapping; individual effects unvalidated.

modules.name: BOOT
modules.evidence: IP first-read address 06004000. Other seeds are static candidates: each uniquely matches 64 bytes (24 for 060146C8, 06015FB8, 06016CC8; 16 for 0601032C) of a registered Scenario 2 or 3 V25.1 BOOT seed. Not executed coverage.
modules.stack_return_evidence: The three drawing-command wrappers and the shared queue guard match the registered Scenario 3 V25.1 BOOT byte-for-byte at the same addresses (64-byte unique matches at 06005548, 06005610, 0600570C); same exact one-word stack pop rule.
